## Committees of the Senate {#committees-of-the-senate .unnumbered}

::: {.policy-numbering .policy-start-7}

7. Committees of the Senate

    1. The Senate shall establish standing and other ad hoc or pro tempore committees as specified in the Bylaws.
    2. Other committees and councils that report to or through the Senate shall be designated Senate-appointed university committees.

:::
